extraction.Name: Charging Iron Shooter
extraction.Refused/Protested: No application on file for this patent
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 5, 1919 by C. Abourezk on February 27, 1919
extraction.Buyer: Land was mortgaged for $3,000; then conveyed by deed signed by Charging Iron Shooter and Martha Iron Shooter to John N. Sturdevant for $5,300.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 658785 issued; south half of section 30, township 40, range 27; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 7, 1919; Indian Office form letter dated October 5, 1918 states his application has been approved; conveyance dated March 24, 1919; also signed by Martha Iron Shooter; this man is a full-blood; it is not understood how he would come in on the so-called forced patent
